segments.sn35.8:1.3: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ cakkhusmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.8:1.5: paccuppannassa cakkhussa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.sn35.8:1.6: Sotaṃ dukkhaṃ … pe … ghānaṃ dukkhaṃ … pe … jivhā dukkhā atītānāgatā;
segments.sn35.8:1.10: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītāya jivhāya anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.8:1.12: paccuppannāya jivhāya nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.sn35.8:1.13: Kāyo dukkho … pe … mano dukkho atītānāgato;
segments.sn35.8:1.16: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ manasmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.8:1.18: paccuppannassa manassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotī”ti.
